3893 parapikraino {par-ap-ik-rah'-ee-no}

源於 3844 和 4087; TDNT - 6:125,839; 動詞

欽定本 - provoke 1; 1

record.edic_text:
3893 parapikraino {par-ap-ik-rah'-ee-no}

from 3844 and 4087; TDNT - 6:125,839; v

AV - provoke 1; 1

1) to provoke, exasperate
2) to rouse to indignation

苦；憎恨，惡毒的感受或怨恨
